drafts.text:
I can say it perfectly clean when nothing's on the line.
Wait for the entry. Don't force it. Let the winner run.
Then the funded account opens and every one of those sentences evaporates the second real money is sitting on the other side.
Knowing it was never the hard part.
Keeping it alive once the payout is right there is the whole game. Most days I lose that game.
drafts.source: Built on the still-warm 10 sep 'two different traders' thread. @RealizedTrader's reply (5 likes): 'You can say it clean now... saying it doesn't survive contact with the funded account though.'
drafts.why: Continues a post that's already working (1.1K, 12 replies) with the audience's own sharpest line, while the thread is still live. Confession is the account's strongest lane; the eval-vs-funded gap is his most relatable current struggle. Honest close, no fake fix.
drafts.why_es: Continúa un post que ya funciona (1.1K, 12 respuestas) con la frase más afilada de la propia audiencia, con el hilo aún vivo. La confesión es el carril más fuerte de la cuenta; la brecha eval-vs-funded es su lucha actual más identificable. Cierre honesto, sin arreglo falso.

drafts.text:
Someone told me the funded only feels heavier because I haven't done it enough yet.
That the pressure fades once you've sat in it enough times without flinching.
I want to believe that.
But I keep buying new accounts before I ever sit in one long enough to find out.
Maybe the reps were always the payout. The account is just where I count them.
drafts.source: @vwapx reply (10 likes) on the 10 sep post: 'You are going through desensitization... eventually the funded feels the same as the eval. It's just a psych thing.'
drafts.why: New emotional register, hopeful and reflective instead of pure pain, which the feed needs after a run of loss-heavy posts. Still honest (names the self-sabotage of rebuying). Citable last line. Diversifies tone without leaving the lane.
drafts.why_es: Registro emocional nuevo, esperanzador y reflexivo en vez de puro dolor, que el feed necesita tras una racha de posts de pérdidas. Sigue siendo honesto (nombra el autosabotaje de recomprar). Última línea citable. Diversifica el tono sin salirse del carril.

drafts.text:
I kept blaming the 25k for my losing streak.
Someone made me actually look at the math instead of the feeling.
The 50k never won more often. It just paid more per win because it was bigger.
Same win rate. Same mistakes. More cushion to make them with.
Size was never my edge. It was my excuse.
drafts.source: Open backlog: @chartsmeancash (09 sep) 're-run it in R, if the ratio matches on both sizes size was never the problem.' Analytical close to the 50k/25k loop, distinct from cycle #8's emotional 'room to be human' angle.
drafts.why: Differentiates the account: almost no trading account posts an honest self-audit that kills its own excuse with math. Hard, quotable close. Truth-bomb rotates off the two confessions.
drafts.why_es: Diferencia la cuenta: casi ninguna cuenta de trading publica una autoauditoría honesta que mata su propia excusa con matemáticas. Cierre duro y citable. El truth-bomb rota respecto a las dos confesiones.
